query:
SELECT 
  o.shopName,
  SUM(CASE WHEN op.productName LIKE '%S1 Pro%' OR op.productName LIKE '%eufy%S1%Pro%' THEN op.quantity ELSE 0 END) as s1pro_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN op.productName LIKE '%E20%' OR op.sku LIKE '%E20%' THEN op.quantity ELSE 0 END) as e20_count
FROM orders o
JOIN orderProducts op ON o.id = op.orderId
WHERE op.isGift = 'no'
  AND (o.shopName LIKE '%ANNIE%' OR o.shopName LIKE '%JOYCE%' OR o.shopName LIKE '%annie%' OR o.shopName LIKE '%joyce%')
  AND (op.productName LIKE '%S1 Pro%' OR op.productName LIKE '%eufy%S1%Pro%' OR op.productName LIKE '%E20%' OR op.sku LIKE '%E20%')
GROUP BY o.shopName
ORDER BY o.shopName;
